import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, json
def run(_context):
    app=adsk.core.Application.get(); out=[]
    for i in range(app.documents.count):
        d=app.documents.item(i); des=adsk.fusion.Design.cast(d.products.itemByProductType('DesignProductType'))
        if not des: continue
        root=des.rootComponent
        out.append({'i':i,'active':bool(d.isActive),'bodies':[{'name':b.name,'bb':[[b.boundingBox.minPoint.x,b.boundingBox.minPoint.y,b.boundingBox.minPoint.z],[b.boundingBox.maxPoint.x,b.boundingBox.maxPoint.y,b.boundingBox.maxPoint.z]]} for b in root.bRepBodies],'sketches':[{'name':s.name,'profiles':s.profiles.count,'bb':[[s.boundingBox.minPoint.x,s.boundingBox.minPoint.y,s.boundingBox.minPoint.z],[s.boundingBox.maxPoint.x,s.boundingBox.maxPoint.y,s.boundingBox.maxPoint.z]]} for s in root.sketches]})
    print(json.dumps(out))
